name: website-build
title: Website Build
description: Build a complete, production-quality static website from structured requirements (blueprint, architecture, design system, approved copy, SEO spec).
when_to_use: Any request that ends in a working website or page set.
instructions: Implement every page and section listed in the blueprint; nothing in the blueprint may be silently dropped.
Semantic HTML5, one stylesheet with design tokens as custom properties, minimal deferred JavaScript as progressive enhancement.
Every page ships with title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and the specified JSON-LD.
Include robots.txt and sitemap.xml; relative links only between pages; no dead anchors.
